liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loose Lucy** (2 reviews): Funky version with blistering Jerry solo work; Reviewer says Jerry seems to struggle with a few verses of Loose Lucy [8][17]
- **Row Jimmy** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Row Jimmy as one of the good moments of the show; Jerry looked the reviewer in the eye two or three times during this Row Jimmy [7][16]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Jerry sounds sloppy with the MIDI earlier in Mexicali Blues [17]
- **Broken Arrow** (1 review): Reviewer's favorite Phil song; this version does not disappoint [18]
- **Liberty** (1 review): Reviewer loved Liberty as first-set closer, thinking it had potential if the band had had time to develop it [11]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer did not find the China Cat/Rider pairing especially inspired [11]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Black Peter as one of the good moments of the show [7]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Placed as second-set closer; reviewer finds it fine but not the most exciting version [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-03-09.sbd.miller.110510.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 3.55/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard finally available for Rosemont shows; reviewer says venue acoustics and audience tapings were poor; Soundboard sound quality is great, especially considering the venue's reputation for poor acoustics [17][18]
- **gd93-03-09.akg.gardner.10084.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 143 min; rated 3/5 by 8 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has the typical Rosemont sound, which is not great; the reviewer calls the sound mediocre [8]
- **gd1993-03-09.AKG451.Darby.119620.Flac1644**: audience recording; 21 songs; 155 min [2]
- **gd1993-03-09.AKG451.Darby.119619.Flac2448**: audience recording; 21 songs; 155 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer drove up from St. Louis at the last minute; weather was bad, and the car had a dead battery [7]
- Crowd was very pumped up; parking lot was cold, with heavy-handed police squashing vendors; inside it was warm [8]
- Security at the venue was extremely harsh, with no shakedown scene; the reviewer says it was worse than the L.A. Sports Arena [10]
- Reviewer's first show, driving from Ithaca, NY; a stranger in the parking lot supplied tickets [14]
- First night of spring tour: weather was nice beforehand, arena got hot inside, and it was snowing after the show [15]
- Reviewer worked toward the stage by Loose Lucy and got repeated eye contact from Jerry during Row Jimmy [16]
- Reviewer's second show, after 6-25-92 at Soldier Field, where the lot scene was far wilder than at Rosemont [10]
- Reviewer saw this as the start of the spring 1993 tour; considered the second Chicago night the highlight of the run [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-03-09.sbd.miller.110510.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Dat (44.1k) [1]. Also: Soundboard source, Miller lineage, flac16; listed setlist runs Playin' into Drums, Jam, The Last Time, Black Peter and Sugar Magnolia [1]
- **gd93-03-09.akg.gardner.10084.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Tony G; source: Audience: AKG 460's [6]
- **gd1993-03-09.AKG451.Darby.119620.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKGC451EB/CK1's (DIN/Section 3 Row 49 Seat 1/6 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes Set 1:Maxell MX-S,Set… [2]
- **gd1993-03-09.AKG451.Darby.119619.Flac2448**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKGC451EB/CK1's (DIN/Section 3 Row 49 Seat 1/6 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes Set 1:Maxell MX-S,Set… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Crimson Records: [GRATEFUL DEAD – Rosemont ’93, March 9 - Crimson Records](https://crimsonrecords.com.ar/product/grateful-dead-rosemont-93-march-9/) [20]
